THE CONSTRUCTION · A CLOSER LOOK

The Anatomy
of a Perfect Suit

Scroll to discover the details. Every line, layer and finish has a purpose — revealed one craft at a time.

MAISON AURUM · DETAIL STUDY 01—06
01 / THE LAPEL

Precision
in Every Fold

The notch lapel frames the chest with a clean, confident line. Its roll is shaped to sit naturally, giving the jacket a refined silhouette from every angle.

Structured notch lapel
02 / THE SHOULDER

A Clean, Strong
Shoulder Line

Carefully balanced canvas and light structure create a smooth shoulder profile without unnecessary bulk, allowing the jacket to follow the body's natural line.

Soft structured shoulder
03 / THE CHEST POCKET

The Signature
Welt Pocket

A precisely finished chest welt adds a quiet point of distinction. Its placement is aligned to the jacket's proportions for an understated finish.

Hand-finished welt detail
04 / THE FRONT

Balance in
Every Button

The front closure is positioned to preserve the jacket's clean vertical line. Button stance and overlap help define the waist without interrupting the drape.

Balanced front closure
05 / THE SLEEVE

The Finishing
Touch

A neat sleeve finish and a glimpse of shirt cuff complete the composition. The sleeve length is designed to keep the wrist line elegant and precise.

Tailored sleeve finish
06 / THE TROUSER

A Fluid, Refined
Silhouette

The matching trouser completes the suit with a balanced line from waist to hem. Clean pressing and considered proportions bring the full look together.

Matching tailored trouser

Where Fabric Becomes
Architecture

Founded in 1962 on the rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, Aurum has dressed statesmen, artists and industrialists who share one conviction: that clothing is not decoration but the first language of consequence.

Every piece begins with a single length of cloth and ends six weeks later, after 82 individual operations performed entirely by hand.
